title: 8,000 years of ceremonial-site artifacts documented by archaeologist Chris Roberts

tellings.quote: our archaeologist, Chris Roberts, has now documented going back over 8,000 years of artifacts

plain: People are said to have used Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, as a ceremonial site, with artifacts going back more than 8,000 years. Its owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels that the ranch's archaeologist, Chris Roberts, has now documented artifacts from that whole span. Fugal tells it to suggest that people treated the land as special long before modern reports began.
